title: Treadmill deals UK 2026: treadmills, walking pads and rowers
description: Treadmill and rowing machine deals UK: the adidas Run Pad at its 3-month low of £399, plus Concept2, WaterRower and prices worth waiting for.
intro:
**The one treadmill at a genuine low today is the adidas Run Pad at £399 from Very, matching its lowest price in three months (it's £449 at Currys).** For rowing, the Concept2 RowErg is £990 and the WaterRower Original is £1,199, their normal prices; neither brand discounts much, so there's no reason to wait if you've chosen one.

Most other treadmills are at standard prices right now, and some are above their recent lows. Unless you need one today, wait for Black Friday on 27 November or the January sales. Prices were checked on 3 November 2026.

body:
## Treadmill or rower?

A **treadmill** is best if you run or walk outdoors and want to keep going through winter, or if you want to walk while working. A **rower** works your legs, back and arms, is low-impact on knees, and is quieter. Rowers also take up less space when stored: a Concept2 splits in two and a WaterRower stands upright.

## Which type of treadmill to buy

- **Walking pad (about £100–£450):** a flat belt with no handrail, made for walking under a standing desk. Most top out at 6–8 km/h, so you can't run on them. The Urevo above is a typical example.
- **Folding treadmill with incline (about £399–£700):** fine for jogging and interval walking. Look for power incline rather than a manual one, and check the top speed: 15–16 km/h is enough for most runners.
- **Serious running treadmill (about £1,000–£1,500):** 20 km/h, steeper incline, a longer and wider belt and a stronger motor. Worth it if you run several times a week.

## Specs that matter

- **Motor rating:** look for **continuous horsepower (CHP)**. Many cheap treadmills quote 'peak' horsepower, which looks bigger but isn't the same. For regular running, about 3.0 CHP or more is a sensible target; walking needs much less.
- **Max user weight:** buy one rated well above your weight. Machines rated at 130 kg or more usually have sturdier frames.
- **Size and folding:** measure the space, including room behind the belt, and check the folded size. Upright-folding models like the Domyos RUN500 take up the least floor space.
- **Apps:** Zwift, Kinomap and iFIT add virtual routes and classes. iFIT on NordicTrack is a paid subscription, so add it to the running cost.

## When treadmill prices drop

Black Friday (27 November 2026) and Cyber Monday (30 November) are when the most fitness brands cut prices, and prices are often among the lowest of the year again around New Year. NordicTrack says it already has up to £500–£600 off some ranges, but those are 'up to' claims, so compare the exact model across Currys, Argos and John Lewis before you buy. Our [Black Friday 2026 dates guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) has each retailer's start date, and the [Boxing Day sales guide](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/) covers what to expect after Christmas.

## Prices to aim for

- **adidas Run Pad:** £399 is a good price now. Don't pay £449.
- **Reebok i-Run 5.0:** about £340, its recent low.
- **NordicTrack T Series 10:** under £1,000.
- **Concept2 RowErg:** £990 is the price, and it's rarely lower. Fit&Well's 2024 Black Friday roundup still had it at £990.
- **WaterRower:** discounts are rare. The last notable one we know of was £200 off a WaterRower on Amazon on Cyber Monday 2024, so expect to pay full price.

More guides are on our [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/).

## FAQs

### Are treadmills cheaper on Black Friday?

Usually, yes. It's when the most fitness brands run sales, and the January sales are the other good time. Today most treadmills are at standard prices, so waiting a few weeks is worth it.

### Can you run on a walking pad?

Most walking pads are built for walking only, with top speeds of about 6–8 km/h and no handrail. Some, like the adidas Run Pad, are made for jogging too, so check the top speed before you buy.

### Is a Concept2 rower ever on sale?

Very rarely. Its UK price has been £990 for a long time, even on Black Friday, so buy when you're ready rather than waiting for a deal.

### What motor size does a treadmill need?

For walking, almost any home treadmill will do. For regular running, look for about 3.0 continuous horsepower (CHP) or more, and ignore 'peak' horsepower figures.
